title: Epigenetic Modifiers and Synthetic Lethality in Cancer Therapy: Emerging Targets Beyond Traditional Approaches.
snippet: As the field of anticancer drug development is constantly changing, combining synthetic lethality with epigenetic modifiers opens up new possibilities for targets that fall outside the traditional drug target range.
